items.title: Fire reported at Kyiv shopping centre following strikes
items.summary: Reports described a fire at Kyiv's Prospect shopping centre following renewed strikes on the Ukrainian capital. The cause and extent of damage have not been independently verified.

items.title: Further strikes reported in Kryvyi Rih and Kharkiv
items.summary: A Russian military correspondent reported a fire following a strike in Kryvyi Rih and further strikes in Kharkiv. The reports have not been independently verified.
